extracted.name: Baja-Style Chicken Bowl
extracted.description: Make easy Baja-style chicken bowls in minutes with leftover chicken and rice, frozen corn, and a red bell pepper. Top with salsa and cheese and dig in!
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir chicken, corn, and bell pepper in hot oil until heated through and pepper is slightly softened, about 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Spoon rice into two bowls. Divide chicken mixture between the bowls and top with salsa and Monterey Jack cheese.
